overview_description.description: Sav is the GCC's ultimate money app, designed to help users understand money, protect & grow wealth, and manage debt. Built on the foundations of Open Banking, Sav uses Ai to suggest users to the shortest, most efficient path to their money goals. Our mission is to help everyone live beyond the next paycheck, implementing AI effectively to help our users feel less stressed about their money.

about_short_description.short_description: Sav is a financial technology platform that provides personal finance management services, including account aggregation, spending analysis.

product.name: Sav Card
product.description: A prepaid Visa card that allows users to make purchases, earn cashback, and manage transactions via a digital wallet and app.

product.name: Sav MyMoney
product.description: A financial management feature that consolidates bank accounts, categorizes expenses, and provides insights to help users track and manage spending.

product.name: Sav Standard Plan
product.description: A free savings plan offering goal-based savings, instant money transfers, limited free ATM withdrawals, and rewards through Sav Coins.

product.name: Sav Pro Plan
product.description: A paid subscription plan that offers enhanced cashback, unlimited free ATM withdrawals, cashback on bill payments, exclusive rewards, and advanced money management features.

product.name: Sav Gift Cards Store
product.description: A platform within the Sav app to purchase gift cards from multiple brands, offering discounts and facilitating transactions between users and brands.
